inclusivity_exclusivity_source_text: (1) Inclusivity and Exclusivity Of the 50 inclusivity strains analyzed by the SIMUL-qPCR Top 7 STEC Assay, all 50 inclusivity strains were correctly detected by the appropriate PCR target within the Top 7 STEC assay kit collection. Additionally, all 50 strains were correctly identified to contain either the intimin gene, the shiga toxin-producing gene, or both. Of the 30 exclusivity strains, none were detected by the SIMUL-qPCR method.
